$Comment: The yearly keepsake: light the Hollow Lantern with Old Jack, once a season, and keep it.
It inherits the yearly occurrence from Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Base, so each year mints its own
copy and @year in the title reads as that year. Feat files it with the feats, earned only.
The hallowed tag counts it toward The Hallowed. The reward is a Claim, like every achievement
reward but a title or a token: the lantern waits on the achievements page until the player
collects it, so a full bag never costs anyone the year's keepsake.
